skill.summary: A modern text-based browser. Renders web pages in the terminal using headless Firefox.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of taizi-browsh.
- Provides a modern text-based browser using headless Firefox.
- Renders web pages, filters ads, and supports video playback in the terminal.
- Requires both browsh and firefox binaries in your PATH.
- Includes usage instructions and setup tips for local installations.
